permitted_values: GCA_* or GCF_* with version suffix
interpretation: The genome assembly the occurrence was called in.
caveats: Version suffix matters: a re-versioned assembly is a different record.

interpretation: The biological sample the assembly derives from.
caveats: 6,285 distinct BioSamples across 6,288 assemblies: a few samples have more than one assembly.

interpretation: The sequencing project. Used as the resampling cluster for every bootstrap.
caveats: 2,283 projects, but effective count by 1/HHI is 136.9 — the nominal count overstates independence.

derivation: NCBI organism name after harmonisation of synonyms
caveats: Harmonised, so it may differ in spelling from the raw submission.

derivation: first token of the harmonised species name

caveats: 12,811 distinct replicons. Unique only within a versioned assembly.

interpretation: Which compartment the occurrence is in.
caveats: DOCUMENTATION, not prediction. This is why the location layer has no error rate: 0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous, 0 missing coordinates. It holds only because every genome is closed.
A symbol, not a proven phenotype. No MIC or susceptibility data exists here.

interpretation: Family the determinant belongs to; the matching unit for family-conditioned analyses.
caveats: Empty where AMRFinderPlus assigns no family.

interpretation: Drug class the determinant is associated with.
caveats: Association as annotated by the database, not measured resistance.

interpretation: Start coordinate of the determinant on its replicon.
caveats: 1-based inclusive. Part of the primary key.

interpretation: End coordinate of the determinant on its replicon.
caveats: 1-based inclusive. Part of the primary key.
Not used in any distance or class computation.

permitted_values: direct_closed_replicon (and any other value defined in the frozen protocol)
derivation: assigned during the direct replicon join
interpretation: How the compartment assignment was established.
caveats: The whole cohort resolves by direct join; no prediction step exists in this dataset.

derivation: frozen five-class rule over location, MGE context and mobility markers
interpretation: A chromosomal with no MGE marker within +/-10 kb; B chromosomal with >=1 marker; C plasmid with no mobility marker; D plasmid relaxase-positive; E plasmid relaxase and MPF positive.
caveats: OPERATIONAL, not biological. Class A is not 'immobile' and class C is not 'non-mobilizable' — both are statements about what a marker database returned.

derivation: MOB-suite 3.1.9 relaxase / MPF / oriT typing of the replicon
interpretation: Mobility architecture encoded on the replicon.
caveats: Empty for chromosomal rows by construction. 'Predicted' means marker-consistent; no conjugation was performed.

derivation: records which evidence layer supplied the compartment
interpretation: Provenance of the location call, kept separable so a revision of one layer does not silently move another.

derivation: records which evidence layer supplied the plasmid mobility call
caveats: Empty for all 35,140 chromosomal rows (47.26 %) by construction, not by missing data.

derivation: records which evidence layer supplied the chromosomal MGE context call
interpretation: Provenance of the MGE context call.
caveats: Empty for all 39,209 plasmid rows (52.74 %) by construction, not by missing data. The two mobility/MGE emptiness counts are exactly complementary and sum to 74,349.
